_readme: SOURCES.json: which script builds each .glb beside it. Every model here is
generated: there is no hand-edited or downloaded model in this folder, and
the script named is the place to change one (scripts/CLAUDE.md).
`generated` is that script. A bake-lite.mjs row also carries the model it
was decimated `from` and the `ratio`, which is how a bare `bake-lite.mjs`
tests/asset-sources.test.js is the gate: every .glb here is listed, nothing
listed has gone away, and every script named exists.
